pr_body:
Various bug fixes:
* attribute values are now marshaled to json.RawMessages using ctyjson. Before this they were being passed a cty.Values and lost entirely when marshaled to json
* planned_values root module is back! There was some flawed logic where planned values was only showing changes, not no-ops. (deleted values are not seen in planned_values)
* fixing awkward (and wrong) test name.
* properly list change actions e.g. "change", "delete" instead of using stringified plans.Action
* use unique provider keys in jsonconfig so aliased providers don't get merged together

fixes #20028 (sort of - this PR is coming before support for showing state only is merged)

review_comments:
I think for lists it's probably best to turn the unknown into a `null` here because the length of the list could itself be meaningful and so changing it may cause the consumer to produce an incorrect result.

(Removing unknowns altogether from maps and objects is okay because the lengths of those are less commonly significant in their own right.)
